notes: This draft manifest is not yet promoted into the primary phase06_ui_sample_manifest.json.
Its purpose is to continue the regular Phase06 source supply after P10 closed and the formal checkpoint reached 47/47 live passed.
The selected files stay inside the remaining official HarmonyOS-Examples reserve and avoid candidates that still depend on hidden same-package helpers.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a self-contained particle emission page that keeps canvas animation state, inspector-derived coordinates, and TextTimer-driven particle updates inside one controller-owned page shell.

ordered_samples.usage_goal: Add a self-contained date-selection home page that keeps Router param hydration, TabsController ownership, and same-file booking builders inside one controller-owned page shell.

tag_rules.resolution_rule: Each file-level sample must resolve to exactly one structure_tag and one ownership_tag. interaction/exception/sample_scope tags are additive only.
